Project description VR-124736
 Join our Development Center in Bucharest, and become a member of our open-minded, progressive and professional team. In this role you will be working on projects for one our world famous clients.
 You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise of the industry of our client.
 On top of attractive salary and benefits package, Luxoft will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career.
 Responsibilities 
 Perform functional, regression, integration, load and stress testing
 Identify bugs and issues, maintain documentation
 Coordinate bug fixes with Development teams
 Maintain test environments
 Develop and extend in-house testing automation tools and test frameworks
 Develop QA Processes and Procedures
 Plan and implement full set of test automation activities: create, maintain and execute automated tests
 Working in a global environment with distributed delivery teams developing microservices to meet the functionalities required by the business
 Participate in full development cycle
 Work with BAs and Engineers on functional and non-functional requirements
 Collaborate with other teams to build systems and integrate them together
 Structure the delivery of program elements into epics and user stories, and facilitate integration between various teams output for production releases, with support from BA, Architects, and Scrum Masters / Product Owners
 Participate with development teams in release management and process improvement
 Automate test cases and maintain automation framework
 Skills 
 Must have
 5+ years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer
 UI web front end automation tools testing experience
 Hands on Experience in REST API testing tools, Gherkin/Cucumber, CI/CD tools integrations
 Experience with dev platforms such as BitBucket/GitHub, Artifactory
 Strong technical vision and hands-on experience in software development and test automation, including BDD and TDD
 Automate test cases and maintain automation framework
 Proven experience of delivering results in matrixed organizations under pressure and tight timescales
 Test issues and risks management
 Prior experience working with Scrum practices and Agile software methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence). Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
 Test planning, test design, and test execution
 Test automation framework development and maintenance
 Defect identification, tracking, and root cause analysis
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 AI-assisted test case generation from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
 Effective use of Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and other AI-enabled testing tools.
 Prompt engineering for testing use cases and quality scenarios.
 AI-assisted automation script generation and maintenance.
 AI-driven test data generation and test environment preparation.
 Drive adoption of AI tools and practices across testing activities.
 Leverage AI to generate and optimize test cases, test data, and automation scripts.
 Use AI-assisted analysis to improve defect detection, root cause investigation, and test coverage.
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
 Nice to have
 Hands-on experience with GCP
